guaranteesTheEscrowReliesOn.enforcedBy: constructor: `if (!sFirst && !(t0 == phUSD_ && t1 == sUSDS_)) revert UniPoolerV2__PairTokenMismatch(t0, t1);`

guaranteesTheEscrowReliesOn.property: pair is the router factory's canonical sUSDS/phUSD pair
guaranteesTheEscrowReliesOn.enforcedBy: constructor: `address canonical = IUniswapV2Factory(IUniswapV2Router02(router_).factory()).getPair(sUSDS_, phUSD_); if (canonical != pair_) revert UniPoolerV2__PairNotCanonical(canonical, pair_);`
guaranteesTheEscrowReliesOn.consequence: the escrow's _pair is the same pair Router02.addLiquidity seeds; and the pair cannot be swapped out if poisoned (LOCAL-001 in escrow profile)

guaranteesTheEscrowReliesOn.property: can receive ERC20/LP passively (no hooks, no receive needed)

inboundValueFromEscrow.custody: held as POL; exit only via owner rescueERC20(pair, to, amt)

inboundValueFromEscrow.how: pair.skim(newPooler) when pair has unsynced donation and 0 reserves
inboundValueFromEscrow.custody: sUSDS feeds pool() zaps; phUSD has no consumer other than rescueERC20
consumed by pool(sUSDSIn, minPhusdOut, minLP) zaps

relevantStateAndGuards.pool(uint256 sUSDSIn, uint256 minPhusdOu: onlyAuthorizedPooler, whenNotPaused, nonReentrant; calls pair.sync() first; reverts UniPoolerV2__EmptyPair on unseeded pair (so cannot pre-empt the escrow seed; any sync it performs pre-seed is rolled back by the revert)
relevantStateAndGuards.rescueERC20(token,to,amount): onlyOwner, any token, to != 0 — sole LP/phUSD exit
relevantStateAndGuards.quotePool: view; sizes from pair balances; reverts on empty pair
relevantStateAndGuards._dispatch: reverts HookNotSet until setHook; wraps USDS->sUSDS onto itself

interactionNotesForDownstream: Post-seed, UniPoolerV2.pool() zaps against reserves that start at the escrow's seed ratio; Q-21 (fix-pending) zap sizing vs cutover seed remains relevant — escrow wrapUsds adds sUSDS to the pooler's zap backlog.
Third parties can call pair.sync() directly at any time; UniPoolerV2 never skims, the escrow skims only on a (0,0)-reserve pair.
Factory feeTo LIVE (Q-23): escrow's seed is the first mint (kLast==0) so no fee is taken at seed; fee accrues thereafter on k growth.
priorFindingsUnchangedByEscrow: L-24 wont-fix (dust pre-seed) — the escrow inherits it as DoS (escrow LOCAL-001)
